translations.web: My sister, my bride, is a locked up garden; a locked up spring, a sealed fountain.
translations.bsb: My sister, my bride, you are a garden locked up, a spring enclosed, a fountain sealed.
translations.kjv: A garden inclosed is my sister, my spouse; a spring shut up, a fountain sealed.
translations.asv: A garden shut up is my sister, my bride; A spring shut up, a fountain sealed.
